gloss: one time only; one-time; once only

definitions.gloss: one time only; one-time; once only
definitions.explanation: Limited to a single occurrence, with no repetition. Used to emphasize that something happens or is available only once.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦クーポン→クーポン：06446_kuupon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一回限|いっかいかぎ}り⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧です。
examples.english: This coupon is valid for one use only.

examples.japanese: {一回限|いっかいかぎ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧な。

⟦{無料体験|むりょうたいけん}→無料体験：09743_muryoutaiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一回限|いっかいかぎ}り⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、ご⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→了承：11415_ryoushou⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please understand that the free trial is limited to one time only.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧ (one time) and ⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧ (limit, only). Functions as a noun that modifies other nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, or stands alone as a predicate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一回限|いっかいかぎ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: a one-time-only special service
- {一回限|いっかいかぎ}り⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧: valid for one use
- {一回限|いっかいかぎ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧: a one-time event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧きり: only once — emphasizes the emotional weight of a single occurrence
- ⟦{単発|たんぱつ}→単発：20543_tanpatsu⟧: one-time, one-shot — used for events, jobs, or projects
- ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧: limited — broader term for limited availability
